# SEO and AI Readiness (Diplomna 4 U)

Purpose: document SEO, indexing and AI-crawler mechanisms in the project.

## Generated files

- `robots.txt` is generated by `scripts/generate-robots.mjs` using `PUBLIC_SITE_URL`.
- `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are generated by `scripts/generate-llms.mjs`.
- Sitemap is generated by `@astrojs/sitemap` in `astro.config.mjs`, with git-based `lastmod`.
- Open Graph and favicon assets are generated by `scripts/generate-og.mjs` and `scripts/generate-icons.mjs`.

## Indexing rules

- City pages without `localContentReady` are added to `NOINDEX_PATHS`.
- Legal pages can be noindexed through `legalNoindex` in `src/data/legal.ts`.
- `public/_headers` returns `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` for `*.pages.dev` hosts.
- `/api/*` has no-store and noindex headers.

## Metadata

- Page metadata uses `BaseLayout.astro`, `src/lib/seo.ts`, `JsonLd.astro` and data files.
- Public URLs use trailing slashes because `trailingSlash: 'always'` is set in Astro config.
- Domain must be provided in `PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, without trailing slash.

## SEO tooling

- `npm run check:seo` verifies titles, descriptions and h1.
- `npm run check:encoding` checks UTF-8 and mojibake.
- `npm run routes` regenerates `docs/ROUTES.txt`.

## Touchpoints

- SEO text rules and local content readiness: `astro.config.mjs`.
- Generated route report: `docs/ROUTES.txt`.
- More detailed audit: `docs/SEO-CHECKLIST.md`.
